title: ste-changed says "unknown" on a shallow clone instead of a false stale-pin warning
why: Named incident, Nov 1 21:4x CST (mailaudit lane): on a shallow claude-settings clone, ste-changed said CI pins ste-lint at 17492e5 "which this copy does not hold", though 17492e5 is an ancestor of main d8037a44. The lane opened an unneeded pin-move lane (cancelled; archived as archive/pin-claude-settings-d8037a4).
note:
Nov 6 11:51 CST (coordinator audit, Explore sonnet; PR head reachable from origin/main): DONE, evidence #1056 on main.
Cause: git merge-base --is-ancestor exits 1 when history is cut (.git/shallow present, rev-list --count origin/main = 1). Fix: before the ancestry read, deepen (git fetch --unshallow or --deepen to the pin), or report "unknown (shallow clone)", never "does not hold" (rule verification-report-unknown-reads). Red first: a shallow fixture clone whose pin is an ancestor beyond the cut gets no stale-pin warning. Cloud sessions clone shallow (clone_depth 50 by default), so it is likely in normal work. Port: yes, ste-changed is shared. Ready. Widened (banchi lane, Nov 1 21:39 CST): two lanes were misled. GitHub compare 17492e5...d8037a44 gives ahead_by 147, behind_by 0, while the shallow clone's is-ancestor said off main. Scope: every check that uses git merge-base --is-ancestor (grep the repo) deepens first (git fetch --unshallow, or --shallow-since past the pin) or uses the compare API, not only ste-changed. Built and reviewed: draft PR #1056, head 15631139, with batch runner 7 (Nov 1 23:32 CST). Six findings in docs/debts/notes.md, none a debt. Lesson: a shallow-clone test must fetch the pin commit into the clone; a plain depth-1 clone stops at "commit not held" and never reaches the bug.
